entry.title: 0.71.2 — Security and privacy fixes with less battery use.
entry.summary:
Security and privacy fixes with less battery use.
5 fixed · 2 smaller
## Fixed
- This release hardens security and privacy and makes Circa lighter on battery. There are no new features. Clear History now erases everything. Clearing your history also removes the deleted pages from the iCloud sync journal and from the synced copies in iCloud. "All Time" and removing a profile also wipe the engine's own internal history files the next time Circa starts. - Icons from websites are checked more strictly before they are displayed, so a malicious page can no longer use an unusual image format to reach the system's image decoder. - Look-alike addresses in the command bar suggestions now show in their real form. An address that imitates another one with foreign letters (for example a Cyrillic "а" in place of a Latin "a") shows as `xn--…`. Normal international addresses such as `münchen.de` still display normally. - The app is signed with narrower system permissions: the main process now refuses to load code that is not signed by Circa, and only the engine processes that need it keep the exceptions. - Deleting history entries is faster on large histories.
## Smaller
- iCloud sync no longer checks in every 5 seconds. It runs when something changes, when iCloud pushes a change, when you come back to Circa, and every 10 minutes as a safety net. This saves battery and disk writes when you are idle. A change made on another Mac can take up to 10 minutes to arrive if its push notification is missed. - Swiping between Spaces with a textured theme repaints much less, and tabs with a custom symbol icon no longer rebuild the sidebar on every update.
## Known limits
- deleting a time range or a single site does not yet clear the engine's internal history, only Circa's own. After this update, the history database cannot be opened by older Circa versions.
